description: Expected assessment prompt outputs for the exposed test signals (ADR 0010, spike T8). Generic impact and nature are judgments, so each case allows a set. Rationale and action are checked mechanically: both present, and every number in the rationale appears in the announcement or the estate summary. Drafted 2026-11-21; confirmed by Simon 2026-11-21.

cases.why: Scheduled prompts leave Power Platform for native Copilot scheduling; flows created by them stop or must be recreated (action required, 31 December).
SharePoint temporary authentication URLs reach end of support; apps, flows and connectors using them break unless migrated.
Service principal authentication becomes available for Copilot Studio workflows; user-owned production flows should move, but nothing breaks.

Third-party agent connections in conversations: a new option for agents on custom web channels; custom web UIs need changes to support it, so behaviour_change is also accepted (Simon, after T8 run 1).
Granular MCP policies for admins (Work IQ): new governance control; agents using MCP may become subject to it.
